notes.title: We have the best tacos at Gamescom
notes.content: [p]Hey Adventurers, [/p][p]what a week - first at Devcom Night we showcased our game as it was selected by the Games Courage Team and got great feedback from game developers. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/9059ed42f4c999ac9b0f18da62e78f16c8340198.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then since start of Gamescom we saw so many happy faces playing our game and giving good feedback. [/p][p]It seems that were are among very few detective games, even more few that are inspired by classic adventure games. And for sure the only game with original Mexican tacos. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/7aa299107dcdc7bf504fb743257bb3925ae56098.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We will open for playtesting soon, so please check back in a bit, if you like tacos and detective work. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/c0d7f0675ea6fc5f05e94f9020d7c6831edf0949.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: German games can be fun
notes.content: [p]Do you have it to save the day? In the Mexican afterworld? With the help of your magic dog Xolo you can do it. Just try. Become a playtester of our upcoming Detective of the Dead and join many testers that already had fun exploring the Mexican underworld, its characters, riddles, puzzles and minigames. Lots of people at DevGamm and more events helped us already making it even more fund and authentic. Reach out to us if you want to play - ideally via email.[/p][p]We're streaming on Steam for a bit during the next days, if you can't wait to see more...[/p][p]Also please head over to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany[/url] to check out other cool games from Games. [/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]your Detective Alejandro [/p]

notes.title: Alejandro and Xolo invited to DevGAMM Gdansk
notes.content:
These days we are in the beautiful city of Gdansk in Poland, because we were selected to showcase our game and also are among 5 games to pitch to a jury, so fingers crossed they like tamale and tacos.

If you are there, please drop by to playtest the latest build we brougth, with new mechanics and now co-op play between Alejandro and Xolo. 

If you can't make it but still want to playtest, please drop us a line and we put you on the list.

notes.title: Rosca de Reyes today - opening of playtester registration
notes.content:
Today on Jan 6th the 3 kings arrive on their horses and as they are the 3 wise men they bring presents for the kids. The long Guadalupe Reyes marathon is over. Piece of cake?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/4778ad61f1f91e534a9a6273662879ed016b7583.jpg[/img]

Everybody is standing in line to get their piece of the delicious Rosca de Reyes cake, hoping the little baby Jesus figure is not in theirs (unless you want to spend a lot). But it tastes so good! Another piece? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/464ab06fa60e420ab87a83f22d6878f4824617ea.jpg[/img]

All kids are queuing to happily destroy the piñata to get sweets and maybe also some money raining down on them. There is something in it for everyone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/c60c3620b69c652a9520f4f2512e9922e9c7d653.jpg[/img]


Well if you like this, then maybe our game is for you.

So from now on the registration for playtesting is open. Lets join and have some fun, as well with piñatas, but it's also helpful if you like detective work.

Team Detective of the Dead

notes.title: Feliz día de los muertos / day of the dead
notes.content:
Become the Detective of the Dead and save the día de los muertos for everybody in our new game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/2fd0c4a4d2739d4c403e67f21c27865c97d1931a.jpg[/img]

Soon on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/michaelgeidel/detective-of-the-dead?ref=5gpmim]Kickstarter[/url]  

 If you enjoyed Grim Fandango or Disco Elysium, it might be just what you like to play. We hope fans of Life is strange, Monkey Island and Sherlock Holmes will also enjoy our game.

We strive to bring you not just great adventure gameplay with metroidvania and RPG elements, but also the colorful Mexican underworld in an authentic way from the story to the puzzles and minigames. You will encounter also quests from dead VIPs you might actually know. And learn how to make the best Taco al Pastor.

Our testers said it reminded them of Grim Fandango and Disco Elysium. And the film Coco. We hope fans of Life is strange, Monkey Island and Sherlock Holmes will also enjoy our game.

Today we invite you to become a tester for our game, play the current version, give us feedback have an impact on the final game. 

On this years Día de los muertos parade in Mexico city and in the city of Morelia in Michoacán we saw our game´s Xolo companion dog was in the parade, what a coincidence! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/a817cb7a8257afce4fce7d5718659a76c2847cde.jpg[/img]

Also we visited the home of Mama Coco. Her ofrenda (altar) shows how dedicated her family is awaiting to meet her again on the day of the dead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/0abc3ad1ce638a97f28168f0624865572f4d9558.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Our Detective at IndieDevDay in Barcelona
notes.content:
Hello Detectives, 
were are super happy that after Deadpool liked our demo at Gamescom now we are at IndieDevDays in Barcelona, the biggest Indie Game event in Spain. Come by out booth and try the latest demo with even more fun, weird humor and mysteries to solve. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109865/48c36165d8cb7933305130bd8be25e038b7304ee.gif[/img]

Check out our stream as well. 

Please consider adding our game to your Wishlist. 

And be prepared for some fun around the upcoming Day of the Dead. 

Also we are soon launching a Kickstarter campaign - and of course it would be great if you follow exclusive news over [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/michaelgeidel/detective-of-the-dead?ref=5gpmim]here[/url].  

See you in Barcelona and on the stream.
